description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling recurrence-related date parsing and formatting, including parsing date strings into Date objects, formatting Date objects into strings, and handling lists of dates.

classes.name: RecurrenceUtil
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and formatting recurrence-related dates.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a Date object based on its format.

methods.name: parseDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of date strings into a list of Date objects.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on its content.

methods.name: formatDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of Date objects into a list of formatted date strings.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current time in milliseconds.
